text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
First, when we arrive by train, we'll have 
lunch at a cafe with delicious sweets. 
Then we'll tour the sightseeing spots—

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
—Woooow! This travel plan is totally 
perfect! —I'm so looking forward to 
tomorrow's trip~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me, everyone. I'll be 
sure to fulfill my duties as tour leader!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"...Due to the impact of localized heavy 
rainfall, train operators have suspended 
service—"

The trip I was looking forward to got 
postponed...
